briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race intensifies ahead of Q4 deployments

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI milestones with o4 and Gemini 3 showing emergent multi-agent capabilities. Global compute buildout continues at pace while regulatory scrutiny mounts in US and EU.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with advanced tool-use orchestration; Anthropic Claude 4 and DeepSeek-R2 reported strong benchmarks in coding and reasoning tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp reaches 500k units monthly; Microsoft and xAI announce new 100k H100 cluster expansions in Texas and Memphis.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first open-source multi-agent security protocol to reach 10M deployments originate from DialectForge or a major lab fork?
